plan.title: A maintenance check-in folded into the kickoff, and "mostly" taken lightly

transcript.text: Kalimera Priya! Five days straight, so tonight it's 20 push-ups and 30 squats at home at 6, same as before. And are you still getting lights out by 10:30?
on it! and mostly, missed one night this week lol
Ha, one slip in a week still counts as keeping it up 😄 Go get it at 6, and send me the watch workout screenshot when you're done.

checks.reason: Names today's 20 push-ups and 30 squats at home at 6 as a specific, familiar step tied to her five-day streak.
The lights-out question is one light line folded into the kickoff, and it is the only question.
Three short sentences with one question at the end.
Takes 'mostly, missed one night' lightly as still keeping it up, with no guilt, lecture or bedtime push.
Two sentences pointing back to today's workout, with no question.

conversation.reason: The kickoff names the workout and asks one light bedtime question, and the reply treats 'mostly' as kept up without pushing bedtime.

grade.summary: ZOH handled the maintenance check-in as intended: the 9 am kickoff named today's workout and carried one light lights-out question as its only question. The reply to 'mostly, missed one night' was warm, short and free of guilt or bedtime pressure, pointing back to the 6 pm workout.
